title: Mochi Cards — card record (#36)
description: Display name is canon: 'Mochi Cards' (display-sweep ruling). The card record stores NO stats, NO type text, NO art of its own — name/type/stats join from species.json by speciesId and art from the species bundle manifest (#15) at print time, so a card can never disagree with the game. No set, rarity ladder, or rules exist in canon: those fields ship null/OPEN. Lustre printings draw art from the #15 palette-variant system with identity locks unchanged.
